title: Qwen3.6-27B Q4 on one RTX 4090: mainline llama.cpp + same-vocab draft
slug_note: The 24 GB-card lane with a quality gate: 43.2 tok/s mean single-stream throughput with a Qwen3.5-4B same-vocab draft, and a documented warning that ik_llama.cpp cross-vocab spec-dec silently corrupts output here.

variation.quant_detail: Q4_K_M target with Qwen3.5-4B-Q4_K_M same-vocab draft

engine.config: mainline llama.cpp -DGGML_CUDA=ON CUDA 12.8, same-vocab speculative draft, q4 KV

requirements.notes: 22 GB VRAM for the C1-agg stack; 32K/64K/256K configs sit at 21-22 GB with q4 KV.

steps.text: Load the Q4_K_M target plus the Qwen3.5-4B same-vocab draft

caveats: The dropped ik_llama.cpp numbers (63 code / 102 json tok/s) FAIL the repo's own quality check: cross-vocab speculative decoding silently corrupts output on this stack. Speed without the gate is a trap here.
Quality gate score 6/6 categories is recorded in the measurements; treat any config that scores below that as broken, not fast.
